messages:
maya patel: Heads-up: planning a fallback-priority reshuffle for model `harbor-13b-v2` in the model catalog during the Wed change window (2026-04-01 23:00–00:30 UTC).
maya patel: Goal is to bump the quantized variant ahead of the pt (float) variant to reduce GPU memory pressure for burst traffic. No model weight changes — just catalog ordering + pin tweaks.
kevin ho: Why now? did something trigger this or is it proactive?
maya patel: Proactive — saw increasing OOM throttles on dedicated pools at 98th percentile bursts. Benchmarks show quant variant keeps same quality for our prompt sets with ~35% less mem.
kevin ho: ok. Any perf tradeoffs on latency?
maya patel: p95 + 8–12ms, p50 unchanged. Worth it for now.
olivia ramos: We should define rollback thresholds before deploy. Suggest: error rate >1.5% over a 5m rolling window OR p95 latency > 2x baseline for 10m.
jordan oncall: FYI eu-west has tighter headroom this week (capacity reservations). If deploybot forces a global reshuffle we could trip evictions. Can we scope regionally?
maya patel: Good call. Plan: regional rollout — NA first (23:00Z), then EU (23:20Z) if telemetry OK. We'll set `regional_exemptions: ['apac']` for this run.
carla eng-release: Need to pin previous ordering for enterprise customers on Dedicated — otherwise some customers expect old variants. We should add an opt-out list.
maya patel: Adding `enterprise_pin: true` for customers in the dedicated_pinlist.
kevin ho: Can you paste the catalog snippet you'll apply?
maya patel: Sure:
```
catalog:
  harbor-13b-v2:
    enable: true
    fallback_order:
      - harbor-13b-v2-quant
      - harbor-13b-v2-pt
      - harbor-13b-legacy
    regional_rollout:
      na: 2026-04-01T23:00Z
      eu: 2026-04-01T23:20Z
      apac: manual-exempt
    enterprise_pinlist: [acct-789, acct-102]
```
deploybot: DeployBot: catalog-change request received for `harbor-13b-v2` by @maya patel. Preflight scheduled: canary 2% for 15m in NA. Will run automated telemetry checks (errors, latency, quality-regression) and post results.
deploybot: DeployBot: To approve run, respond with `@deploybot approve` or `@deploybot hold`. Timeout 30m before auto-cancel.
olivia ramos: Approving from QA as long as canary telemetry alert thresholds (error rate + p95) are enforced.
jordan oncall: Added a regional exemption note in the rollout ticket. If EU fails, deploybot should automatically rollback NA->global? Or keep NA and stop EU?
kevin ho: Keep NA and abort EU. No global rollback unless NA also signals failure.
maya patel: Agree. We'll keep scope local.
carla eng-release: Reminder to include brief release note: what changed, why, rollback thresholds, opt-out instructions, and a sample query for QA. I'll draft.
maya patel: Drafted release note snippet and will push to the release-notes PR after deploy succeeds.
kevin ho: One more ask — add a quick canary eval prompt set (10 prompts) to sanity-check generation quality; if QPS-normalized ROUGE drops >3% trigger rollback.
maya patel: Adding small eval set to the deploybot preflight.
deploybot: DeployBot: preflight tasks queued: canary 2% (15m), telemetry (errors/latency), quality-eval (10 prompts), enterprise-pin apply. ETA start 2026-04-01T23:00Z.
olivia ramos: Logged checklists and will be on watch during canary.
jordan oncall: I'll monitor evictions and gpunode errors.
maya patel: Thanks all — scheduling final run and will post a short summary after the canary. :thumbsup:
kevin ho: :thumbsup:
carla eng-release: :raised_hands:
